usg.text: Tolaria is the island where Urza and Barrin found the Tolarian Academy, and where Urza creates the golem Karn as a probe to survive time travel in his plan to change the past.

Karn uses the time machine to save Jhoira from a Phyrexian sleeper agent, but the machine fails catastrophically, destroying the academy and leaving Tolaria a shattered temporal landscape, and time floods the island in "an instant that stretched toward infinity."
Urza escapes with Barrin and thirteen others, Karn rescues thirty-three more, and Jhoira is stranded alone.
Years later Urza and Barrin return and reestablish the Academy with Jhoira's aid, and the Invasion of Tolaria that follows is ended by Barrin, Jhoira, Teferi and their allies.

ulg.text: Kerrick's corrupt domain swells on Tolaria like a blister, as Kerrick launches the Invasion of Tolaria while Urza is away.
Barrin activates a beacon and Urza returns to destroy Kerrick.

uds.text: Back on Tolaria, Urza realizes he needs an army and an heir and secretly starts the Bloodline Project to create mortal heroes to wield the Legacy against Yawgmoth.
He appoints Rayne chancellor to push her and Barrin toward producing an offspring, and creates the Metathran army amid controversy, as Barrin contests his methods.
Meanwhile Rayne and Barrin find a Capashen blood sample the negator took, revealing a big attack on Benalia is imminent.
